title: Sign-in device-flow: still polling, not yet terminal -- the spinner state, NOT a failure

expected.wizard_terminal: InProgress (device-flow wrapper spinner, still polling at the ceremony's interval)

notes: Not one of the 3 failure variants -- included because 'pending' is a distinct, valid, non-terminal poll response the Rust seam must keep polling on (at the ceremony's `interval` seconds) rather than treat as any kind of holding/error. A test harness driving mock-cc should typically return this a few times before flipping CT_AUTH_SCENARIO to a terminal value, to exercise the polling loop itself.
